name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 65 - Am 144
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 65 a. Stresses that the granting of Union development aid should be made conditional upon the effective cooperation of partner countries in the return and readmission of their nationals residing illegally in the Union; considers that such an approach would strengthen the coherence between the Union’s external policies and ensure a more responsible use of Union funds;
